props.title: Foot Massage for Daily Comfort and Recovery
props.text: Your feet absorb constant pressure throughout the day, whether from walking, standing, travelling, or exercising. Foot Massage focuses on the muscles, joints, and soft tissues of the feet and lower legs using relaxing massage techniques inspired by traditional reflexology. The treatment helps ease built-up tension, improve local circulation, and restore comfort, making it a popular choice after long days exploring Bali or spending hours on your feet.
props.feature1Text: Helps reduce fatigue caused by walking, standing, and everyday activities.
props.feature2Text: Combines relaxing massage with pressure point techniques for added comfort.

props.title: Choose the Right Duration
props.text: Different session lengths allow our therapist to focus on specific areas or provide more detailed care for both the feet and lower legs. Whether you need a quick refresh or a longer recovery session, each treatment is adjusted to your comfort.

props.title: When Is a Foot Massage Most Helpful?
props.text: A Foot Massage can be especially enjoyable when your feet have been working hard throughout the day. Whether you've spent hours exploring Bali, standing for long periods, or travelling, a dedicated foot treatment gives tired feet focused attention. It can be particularly helpful after situations such as:
featuresLeft: Tired feet after sightseeing or exploring
Sore arches or heels after extended walking
Foot fatigue following a long flight
featuresRight: Tired feet after standing for several hours
Muscle fatigue after light physical activities

props.title: Where Does Foot Massage Work?
props.text: A Foot Massage focuses on several areas of the feet and lower legs that can become tired or tense throughout the day. Each area receives focused attention to help create a more comfortable and relaxed feeling. The massage may focus on:
featuresRight: Calf muscles that can contribute to foot tension
Toes and the surrounding soft tissues

props.title: How Our Foot Massage Is Performed
props.text: Our Foot Massage uses a combination of gentle techniques to work through tension in the feet and lower legs. Warm natural oils help create smooth, comfortable movements, while focused pressure is applied to areas that may feel particularly tired after walking or standing. The treatment can be tailored to your comfort, with techniques such as:
featuresLeft: Warm oil for smooth massage movements
Reflexology-inspired pressure on key foot zones
featuresRight: Focused attention on the arches and heels
Massage of the lower legs and calves
Pressure adjusted to your comfort level

items.question: Is Foot Massage the same as reflexology?
items.answer: Not exactly. A foot massage at Spa Bali Moon focuses on relaxing muscles, relieving soreness and improving comfort throughout the feet and lower legs. Reflexology traditionally follows pressure points believed to correspond with different parts of the body. Our treatment uses selected reflexology-inspired techniques while remaining a relaxing massage experience.

items.question: Can Foot Massage help after walking all day?
items.answer: Yes. Many guests book a foot massage at Spa Bali Moon after sightseeing, shopping or long walks around Bali, because it helps reduce tiredness and discomfort in the feet, arches, heels and calves. A 1-hour session is IDR 159.000 per person, at our Seminyak spa or at selected hotels and villas.

items.question: Does the massage include the lower legs?
items.answer: Yes. Depending on the session you choose, your Spa Bali Moon therapist also massages the ankles and lower legs to ease muscle tightness connected to tired feet. Longer sessions of 1.5 hours (IDR 239.000) or 2 hours (IDR 330.000) give more time for the lower legs as well as the soles and heels.

items.question: Is strong pressure used?
items.answer: Not necessarily. Your therapist adjusts the pressure to your comfort, from gentle to firmer, and you can ask for a change at any point during the session. A foot massage at Spa Bali Moon is meant to be soothing while still giving tired feet real relief, with warm natural oils and focused pressure on tired areas.

items.question: Can I book Foot Massage at my hotel or villa?
items.answer: Yes. Spa Bali Moon offers foot massage as home service at selected hotels, villas and accommodations around Seminyak, for an extra IDR 75.000 per therapist on top of the treatment price, from IDR 159.000 for 1 hour. Send your location and preferred time on WhatsApp at +62 878-6317-5144, between 9am and 11pm.

items.question: Does foot massage help neuropathy?
items.answer: Foot massage may help relieve discomfort and promote relaxation, but it does not treat the underlying cause of neuropathy. If you have reduced sensation in your feet, speak with a healthcare professional before booking a massage, and tell your Spa Bali Moon therapist before the session so the pressure can be kept gentle and comfortable.

items.question: Is foot massage good for plantar fasciitis?
items.answer: Foot massage may help ease tension and discomfort associated with plantar fasciitis, and gentle massage of the soles and heels can be particularly soothing. It should not replace professional treatment when symptoms persist. Tell your Spa Bali Moon therapist where it hurts before the session, so they can keep the pressure comfortable.

items.question: Can I get a foot massage while pregnant?
items.answer: Foot massage can be relaxing during pregnancy, but it is best to check with your healthcare provider first, especially if you have any pregnancy-related complications. Let your Spa Bali Moon therapist know that you are pregnant before the session starts, so they can adjust the treatment and the pressure accordingly.

items.question: Why does a foot massage feel so good?
items.answer: A foot massage can feel good because it relaxes tense muscles, stimulates the feet and promotes a sense of calm. The combination of gentle pressure, warm natural oils and soothing movements can also help reduce everyday stress. At Spa Bali Moon in Seminyak, a 1-hour foot massage is IDR 159.000 per person.

items.question: How much does a foot massage cost in Seminyak?
items.answer: A foot massage at Spa Bali Moon in Seminyak costs IDR 159.000 for 1 hour, IDR 239.000 for 1.5 hours and IDR 330.000 for 2 hours per person. For a shorter session, 30 minutes of foot reflexology is IDR 99.000. Home service at selected hotels and villas adds IDR 75.000 per therapist.
